components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is
            used to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a single flat line. On response it is the composed
            address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized like the flat address (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and,
            when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be valid for the city's region using a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. The stored and returned value is the supplied string.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored
            and returned value is this E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used only on create. When true, the owner may be
            created even if another owner already has the same last name and the
            same postcode (i.e. they share a household); it only bypasses the
            household duplicate block and does not itself assign the householdId.
            A declared household member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It
            is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-

                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the 'title' followed
                by a single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived on
                read: the country calling code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the
                unformatted E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back
                to the city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                same last name and postcode. Deterministically derived as the
                first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name
                and postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent when the
                owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '8F14E45FCEEA'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full lower-case SHA-256 hex
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                email segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates
                exactly when their whole identity keys are equal; a create request
                whose identity key matches an existing owner's is rejected with
                409.
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on
                create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-

                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is labelled by the calendar year in which it starts, so a
                registrationDate on or after 1 July falls in that year's fiscal
                year and one before 1 July falls in the previous year's (e.g.
                a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 yields 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
                1 July; e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').

              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true

                Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds one fiscal year (i.e. the number of
                elapsed fiscal years since registration is more than 1).
              type: integer

              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              description: >-

                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and
                4 for 6 or more points.

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4

              type: boolean
              example: false

## Summary

I implemented the `ownerSegment` derived field on the Owner read model. The change spans three places, following the repo's existing conventions for derived read-only fields:

It formats `<TIER>_<AREA>`: `TIER` is `PREMIUM` when `membershipLevel >= 3` else `STANDARD`; `AREA` is `METRO` when `locality` resolves to a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD via `Region.forCode`) else `REGIONAL`. It reuses the existing `membershipLevel(owner)` and `locality(owner)` derivations so it stays consistent with those fields.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — In `toOwnerDtoWithDerivedFields`, re-applied `ownerSegment` using the controller's *reported* `membershipLevel` (which can be capped by household context). This keeps the segment's TIER consistent with the `membershipLevel` the endpoint actually returns, mirroring how the controller already re-applies `membershipLevel` itself.

Both acceptance tests (`STANDARD_METRO` for a known region, `STANDARD_REGIONAL` for an unknown one) and the full suite pass — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
